cohort: Pregnant women, >18 years of age, with Singleton pregnancy, who underwent a third trimester USG Doppler at 35-37 weeks (n=283)
finding: Cerebro-placental ratio <1 at 35-37 weeks of gestation was significantly associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including MSL, Caesarean section, and utero-placental and cerebro-placental insufficiency.
mod_finding: There was a significant statistical association between mode of delivery and low/normal CPR, with a higher incidence of Caesarean section in cases with low CPR.
